takes/20_doctora.mp3.txt: Pain killers like ibuprofen don't heal the wound. They stop your body from making prostaglandins, the chemicals that make your nerves send pain signals to your brain. So the pain fades, even though the medicine never went looking for the injury. It just turned the signal down.
